name: Aetheric Storm
description: Blue and violet lightning crackles across the horizon, flashing through the sky in unnatural colors. Electronics fail. The air tastes like copper.

name: Aether Lightning
description: Bolts of blue-purple energy strike without thunder. Each flash leaves an afterimage burned onto the eye.

name: Ash Storm
description: A wall of grey ash rolls across the plain. Breathing burns. Skin gathers a film of dead world.

name: Black Rain
description: Rain the color of old oil. It pools on Aetherstone and refuses to soak in.

name: Iron Fog
description: A dense rust-colored fog that smells of forge and old blood. Compasses spin.

name: Glass Hail
description: Crystalline shards rain down like a windowpane shattering in slow motion. Aetherstone hums where they strike.

name: Whisper Fog
description: A low-hanging mist that murmurs in old Tartarian. Step too far in and you forget which century you came from.

name: Silent Blizzard
description: Snow that absorbs all sound. Your footsteps make no noise. Your screams make less.

name: Eerie Calm
description: Not even wind. The kind of stillness that means something is watching.
